_comment: The cast's every spoken word. Writers own this file; no code changes required to edit any of it. Ids match src/sim/npcRoster.ts. Chatter pools are drawn with the seeded RNG and never repeat within a day. {player} is never used — nobody here knows your name, which is the joke.

steve: You ever notice the vending machine gives you an extra one if you buy at 4:55? I don't make the rules.
I told Regional I'd have it Thursday. I didn't say which Thursday.
Big weekend. Big, big weekend. Can't say more. Legal reasons. I'm joking. It's a boat show.
They moved my parking space. Not to anywhere. Just off the list.
If anyone asks, we had this conversation about the Q3 numbers.
I've been here nine years. I've been in this chair four hours.
Do you ever think about how the fax just — goes? Into the wall? And comes out somewhere?
My doctor says I should stand more. So I've been taking longer lunches.
marjorie: Interoffice goes in the grey tray. The grey one. I won't say it again, but I will.
Twenty-two years. I've outlasted four managers and one entire floor.
There's a memo coming about the memos. I've seen the draft. It's not good.
Dale's on his second coffee and it's not ten. Make of that what you will.
They used to have a Christmas party. Then someone brought a guitar.
I know what's in everyone's out-tray. I don't read them. I don't have to.
The plant by the boss's office is plastic. I dust it anyway. It's not the plant's fault.
Pat submitted an expense for a stapler. Itemised. Two pages.
Whatever you've heard about the fourth floor, halve it, then believe the half.
dennis: Is it plugged in. I have to ask. I'm required to ask.
That's a known issue. It's been known for some time.
I can raise a ticket. The ticket will go to me. I'll see it tomorrow.
The server room is at nineteen degrees. It's the only honest room in the building.
Someone microwaved fish and it got into the ventilation and now it's in the backups. Conceptually.
Have you tried turning it off. And then leaving it off. And going home.
I don't fix printers. I've never fixed a printer. Printers are a rumour.
Your password expires in four days. It expired four days ago. Both are true.
pat: Receipts must be attached. Not stapled through the total. Through the margin.
That's a Form 7. You've filled in a Form 7-A. They are extremely different.
I have flagged it. Flagging is not escalating. Escalating is a separate form.
The thermostat is set to twenty-one. It has always been twenty-one. It will remain twenty-one.
I don't take lunch at noon. Everyone takes lunch at noon. I take lunch at 12:15.
Mileage is reimbursed at the rate in effect on the date of travel, not the date of claim.
I've read the handbook. All of it. Twice. There's a typo on page forty and it haunts me.
You can't expense a coffee unless someone else drinks one too. That's not my rule.
dale: Good, good. Keep at it. Whatever it is.
I like to walk the floor. Keeps me close to the work. Close to the people.
We're all one team. Some of us are more one team than others.
I don't want to hear problems. I want to hear solutions. Or nothing. Nothing's fine.
Big picture? Big picture, we're fine. Don't look at the small picture.

stories._comment: The long one. Sitting through it costs real in-game minutes and earns a favor token. Each has a mid-point where the player could leave, which is the whole design: the favour is that you didn't.

steve.open: Oh — do you follow fantasy? Because I have to tell somebody about my running back.
steve.middle: So I trade Dwayne. I trade Dwayne on the Tuesday. And you know what happens on the Wednesday.
steve.end: Anyway he's out for the season. Thanks for listening. Genuinely. Nobody else does.
steve.leave: No, no. Go. You're busy. Everyone's busy.

marjorie.open: Sit down a moment. Did I ever tell you about the fire drill of '91?
marjorie.middle: Nobody told the fourth floor. So they're standing in the car park in February, and one of them is holding a cake.
marjorie.end: That's why the alarm is on the OTHER wall now. Everything in this building is like that. Everything.
marjorie.leave: Go on then. It's a better story when you've got time for it.

dennis.open: You're the third person today. Do you want to know what the actual problem is?
dennis.middle: It's the phone system. It's always the phone system. They bought it in '89 and it has opinions.
dennis.end: So no, I can't fix it. Nobody can fix it. We're just its neighbours now. Nice of you to hear me out.
dennis.leave: Sure. Everyone leaves at that part.

pat.open: While you're here. There's something in the handbook you should probably know.
pat.middle: Section four. Subsection C. It contradicts subsection A, and both are still in force.
pat.end: I wrote to Head Office about it in 1993. I keep the reply in my drawer. Thank you for listening.
pat.leave: That's alright. It's a lot. It's genuinely a lot.

greetings._comment: One line when a conversation opens, before options. Varies by how much favor the player holds with that person — the relationship is legible in how they greet you before any number is shown.

neutral.steve: Hey! You're the one who's always at the fax.
neutral.marjorie: There you are. Hold this a second.
neutral.pat: You've caught me between things. Briefly.
neutral.dale: There he is. Working hard, I see.

warm.marjorie: Come here, you. I've got one for you.
warm.dennis: Oh, it's you. Fine. Fine, come in.
warm.pat: I've been meaning to catch you, actually. In a good way.
warm.dale: There he is. Whatever you're doing, keep doing it.

steveScenario._comment: THE scene. Steve leaves at 11:40 for a 'quick lunch' and returns at 2:15. Dale asks after him at a seeded point in between. This is the game's first real moral compromise and every branch must cost something.

ask.open: Listen. Listen. Are you doing anything for the next two hours?
ask.detail: Because I'm not going to be doing anything for the next two hours. Officially I'm at the printer.
ask.stack: There's a stack on my desk. It's four faxes. It's nothing. If Dale asks, I'm at the printer and the stack is handled.

choices.cover: "You're at the printer. I'll do the stack."
choices.coverPartial: "You're at the printer. I'm not touching the stack."
choices.decline: "I'm not lying to Dale for you."

replies.cover: You're a good one. You're one of the good ones. I'll remember this.
replies.coverPartial: That's fair. That's more than fair. The stack can rot, honestly.
replies.decline: No — no, that's fine. That's completely fine. Forget I said anything.
replies.needle: It's a lunch. It's a normal-length lunch. It's a lunch with a drive attached.

daleAsks.open: You seen Steve? I've been past his desk twice.

replies.coverChecked: The printer. I've just come from the printer.
replies.shrug: Mm. Nobody's seen him. Remarkable, that.
replies.report: Twenty to twelve. Well. Thank you for being straight with me. I'll remember that.

aftermath.steveGrateful: Heard you held the line. Anything you need. Anything.
aftermath.steveBurnedLater: I'm not angry. I want to be clear that I'm not angry.
aftermath.caughtOut: So Steve's at the printer, is he. I'll let you sit with that one.
aftermath.stackUnsent: The stack's still on my desk. It's fine. I'm not — it's fine.

favors._comment: How a token is granted and spent. The grant line must land as a MOMENT, not as a number ticking up — a token with no memorable acquisition is bookkeeping.

granted.steve: Steve owes you one. He has said so, twice, at volume.
granted.marjorie: Marjorie owes you one. She will not forget. She has never forgotten anything.
granted.dennis: Dennis owes you one. He'd deny it, but he's written it down somewhere.
granted.pat: Pat owes you one. It has been logged, correctly, on the appropriate form.

none.steve: He'd want to. He would. He just wouldn't.
none.marjorie: "Ask me when you've earned it, love."
none.pat: "That would be inappropriate at this time."

capped.steve: Steve cannot owe you more than he already does. It's a lot for him.
capped.marjorie: "You're well in credit. Spend some of it."
capped.dennis: "We're square several times over. It's uncomfortable."
capped.pat: "Your balance is at the documented maximum."

sinks._comment: What a token buys. Every one is real today: the fax, the clock, the boss, the meters. {times} is filled from Dale's actual schedule.

marjorie.label: Ask what Dale's up to
marjorie.line: "He'll be down your aisle at {times}. You didn't hear it from me. You never do."
marjorie.exhausted: "He's done his rounds. You're safe as houses till five."

dennis.label: Ask about the fax
dennis.line: "Fine. One thing, and we never spoke. Write it down, because I won't say it twice."
dennis.exhausted: "You already know everything I know. That's genuinely unsettling."

steve.label: Ask him to take one
steve.line: "Say no more. Give me the ugly one." He takes the top of your tray and ambles off.
steve.exhausted: "You've got nothing in the tray. Look at you."

pat.label: Ask her to sign one off
pat.line: "I'll date it as received this morning. I'm not comfortable. But I'll do it."
pat.exhausted: "There's nothing outstanding to date. Which is how it should be."

steve_lookout.label: Ask him to keep an eye out
steve_lookout.line: "Say no more. If he heads your way, you'll know about it."
steve_lookout.exhausted: "I've already coughed for you once today. People are noticing the cough."

decay._comment: People forget. Narrated on the Friday BEFORE it happens rather than the Monday after, so it reads as a relationship cooling rather than the game taking something.
decay.warning: You have not spoken to {name} all week. That is the sort of thing that gets noticed, quietly.
decay.lapsed: {name} has stopped mentioning that thing you did. It has passed into the general past.

ui._comment: Footer lines for the conversation box. {min} is the story's time cost.
ui.offer: E — stay and listen ({min} min)   ·   Esc — get back to it
ui.noMoreWalks: he's done his rounds for today

fluff._comment: Getting caught. Silence is the COMMON case — Dale looking, saying nothing and walking on is the whole joke about this office — so `silent` fires most of the time and the written lines are the rare payoff. Tier lines escalate with today's offence count.
silent: Dale slows as he passes. He does not look at the screen. He does not need to.
Dale glances down, then away, and keeps walking. Nothing is said. Nothing will be.
He pauses at the mouth of your cubicle for exactly one second longer than a person would.
first: "Good, good. Keep at it." He has already gone.
"Don't let me interrupt." He waits until you close it. Then he waits a bit longer.
"I'm not going to say anything. I'm just going to have known."
repeat: "Second time today. I'm counting, which is the part you should mind."
"You know what, I admire the commitment. To the cards, I mean."
"We should get you something to do. I'll think about what."
pat: Pat notes something on a pad. She does not look up. There will be a form.
"I'm not going to escalate this. Escalating is a separate process."
fluff.gotAway: He's gone. Your hand is still there.
fluff.lookoutBought: "Say no more. If he heads your way, you'll know about it."
fluff.lookoutSpent: {name} has already coughed for you once today. He looks tired.

venue.cooler: You stand near the cooler and let a few minutes go by.
venue.bathroom: Nobody can see the bathroom. That is its entire appeal.

cards._comment: Rank glyphs are player-facing text, so they live here. ranks.length must equal BALANCE.fluff.solitaire.ranksPerSuit.
cards.title: Solitaire
cards.hint: ←→ pick  ·  ↑ to foundation  ·  Space draw  ·  Esc close
cards.won: You have won. Nobody will ever know.
